alerts.note: Paste here the Web app URL of docs/alert-relay.gs (a Google Apps Script that e-mails the Google account that deploys it, so no address is written into the site), or any form-to-email endpoint, to receive an e-mail when the page detects an injection attempt, framing, machine-speed scraping or an unofficial copy. Network attacks are reported by Cloudflare's own e-mail notifications. See SECURITY.md, Layer 3.
